 "study": "Saslow LA 2018",
 "design": "parallel 2-arm",
 "country": "USA",
 "duration": "32 weeks",
 "n_randomized_total": "25",
 "experimental_arm": {
  "label": "intervention",
  "intervention_description": "ad libitum very low-carbohydrate ketogenic diet with lifestyle factors (physical activity, sleep, positive affect, mindfulness)",
  "n_randomized": "12",
  "n_analyzed": "12 (week 16), 11 (week 32)",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.8",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "-0.8% (95% CI –1.1% to –0.6%)",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "CI95: –1.1 to –0.6",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "5.8",

  "hba1c_final_mean": "NR",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "NR"
 },
 "control_arm": {
  "label": "control",
  "intervention_description": "online diet program based on American Diabetes Associations’ “Create Your Plate” diet (low-fat plate method)",
  "n_randomized": "13",
  "n_analyzed": "8 (week 16), 8 (week 32)",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.3",

 }
